sloka: मृत्युरक्षमणीयम् माम् नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ।मृते मयि गते रामे वनम् मनुजपुङ्गवे ॥२-१२-८९॥
transliteration: mṛtyurakṣamaṇīyam mām nayiṣyati yamakṣayam ।mṛte mayi gate rāme vanam manujapuṅgave ॥2-12-89॥

translations.english: With me dead and Rama, the best among men, banished, what harmful acts are you contemplating against my wellwishers?
